_how_to_fill: Setup rebuilds every value marked EXAMPLE from the user's search profile and confirms the exclusion list with the user. Regexes are case-insensitive Python regex. Keep title_include broad and let Claude judge fit; use title_exclude for seniority and the user's own dealbreakers. search_terms are the short role phrases the aggregators search for (5-10 from the lanes). location.metro is the user's metro as 'City, ST'. aggregators: the keyless ones are on by default; keyed ones (adzuna, usajobs, jooble, serpapi, jsearch) switch on once their keys are filled in. bulk_lists scans thousands of extra company boards from a public list each run (adds ~3-4 minutes).
